hints.title: Probabilistic Multilevel Linking
hints.text: A skiplist maintains multiple ordered forward lists where higher levels skip over elements to accelerate traversal.

hints.title: Coin Toss Height Promotion
hints.text: Promote newly inserted nodes to higher levels with 50 percent probability, linking new levels into the predecessor update array.

hints.title: Skiplist Traversal Blueprint
hints.text: Drop through levels from top to bottom moving right while next value < target. Record predecessor pointers at each level for insertion.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log N) average search, add, erase
variables: N: number of elements in the skiplist
complexity.notes: Probabilistic doubling yields geometric level heights with logarithmic average height.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single linked lists require O(N) sequential traversal; balanced trees require complex rotation logic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Multiple forward pointers trade geometric memory overhead for expected logarithmic search bounds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Multi-level forward link structure, coin-toss level generation, and predecessor update tracking.

solutions.approach: Probabilistic Skip List with Predecessor Updates
